cohort: The study included pre- and full-term newborn Sprague-Dawley rat pups.
finding: Cesarean delivery and formula feeding are associated with lower levels of intestinal alkaline phosphatase (IAP) expression and activity, while neither prematurity nor formula feeding led to differences in intestinal injury in this model.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery is associated with lower levels of intestinal alkaline phosphatase (IAP) expression and activity compared to vaginal birth.
